summary: Pre-deploy QA passed. 383/383 tests green. Full operator flow (prep -> stage -> preview -> publish) runs end-to-end on tempfile DB with admin ping matching byte-for-byte and row migrating to published_articles with via_review=1. All locally-verifiable AC satisfied; 4 criteria deferred to Task 15 (live Telegraph/Telegram visual validation).

acceptance_criteria.description: Prep-phase does not publish to channel directly.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: tests/test_job_prep_phase.py asserts mock_publish.assert_not_called(); Task 6 (0140a98) deleted process_new_articles; job() smoke confirmed zero teaser calls during prep.

acceptance_criteria.description: Each new entry from each source persisted with original fields and empty ru_* at INSERT.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: tests/test_job_prep_phase.py; tests/test_sources_registry.py; smoke run confirmed 3 rows with ru_* NULL.

acceptance_criteria.description: pending_articles has UNIQUE on link (PK) -- duplicate inserts return False.
Admin ping sent only when queue non-empty; byte-exact '<N> ждут review: 🟠 autoevolution ×K, 🟣 mattel ×M, 🟢 lamley ×L'.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: tests/test_admin_ping.py (25 cases); smoke: ping_text == '3 ждут review: 🟠 autoevolution ×1, 🟣 mattel ×1, 🟢 lamley ×1'.

acceptance_criteria.description: hw_review list: 'queue is empty' on empty; numbered rows on non-empty; failed footer always if failed non-empty.
hw_review stage N rejects partial staging with clear error.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: tests/test_hw_review_cli.py stage JSON validator (8 vectors incl. partial).

acceptance_criteria.description: hw_review preview N without stage returns 'nothing to preview — stage Russian text first'; with stage renders HTML and opens browser.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: tests/test_hw_review_cli.py preview tests; smoke --no-open printed cache path and file exists.

acceptance_criteria.description: hw_review publish N in one command creates Telegraph page + sends channel post + moves to published.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: tests/test_hw_review_publish_flow.py (15 cases); smoke: row moved to published_articles with via_review=1 after single publish call.

acceptance_criteria.description: Telegram failure after Telegraph OK: pending row retained; retry reuses stored Telegraph URL (no 2nd createPage).
hw_review publish N on vanished/published/failed row returns clean error referencing state, no traceback.
Queue exactly 10 + 0 new -- overflow fast-track doesn't run.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: tests/test_overflow.py guards `count_pending() + len(new) > QUEUE_CAP` predicate; empty-entries no-op case.

acceptance_criteria.description: hw_review skip N with staged ru requires y/N confirmation; on y writes dedup + deletes pending; no published.
hw_review take N clears notified_at, row stays pending.
hw_review take N after grace + auto-publish returns 'N already auto-published'.
Row idle >48h gets heads-up ping + auto-publish after grace with via_review=False.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: tests/test_idle_fallback.py (12 cases); SQL-based time simulation; consolidated ping verified.

acceptance_criteria.description: Queue never exceeds 10 pending; overflow fast-tracks only ru-NULL rows.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: tests/test_overflow.py; list_pending_for_eviction filters ru_paragraphs IS NULL (Decision 7).

acceptance_criteria.description: fast-track GT failure: queue stays, new dropped, admin pinged; overflow failures share attempt_count; 3 strikes -> failed.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: tests/test_overflow.py + tests/test_idle_fallback.py; repo increment_attempt test at 3 strikes.

acceptance_criteria.description: hw_review list always shows failed footer '⚠️ K неопубликованных в failed: [titles]. hw_review retry N чтобы переподнять.' (byte-exact).
hw_review retry N moves row from failed back to pending with attempt_count=0 and fresh fetched_at.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: tests/test_hw_review_retry.py (14 cases incl. 6 TDD anchors); pending_articles_repo::retry_from_failed tests.

acceptance_criteria.description: Mattel hooked via shared registry (adding source = editing one list).
Dedup table contains link for every published OR skipped article.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: tests/test_pending_articles_repo.py move_to_published + skip_pending both write to processed_news; smoke verified dedup row after publish.

acceptance_criteria.description: CLI uses same logger as news_bot; exit 0 on success, non-zero on error; hw_review show N displays row state.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: tests/test_hw_review_cli.py; CLI smoke matrix (9 subcommand --help all exit 0).

acceptance_criteria.description: init_db() idempotent: second call is no-op.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: tests/test_migration.py; smoke: called twice, no error, 4 tables present.

acceptance_criteria.description: insert_pending UNIQUE-conflict returns False.
Multi-table repo mutators use explicit commit/rollback transactions.
hw_review preview --no-open exits 0 and prints path; no webbrowser.open call.
hw_review publish N on out-of-range: exit 1 + referenced state, no traceback.
_fetch_rss_entries sets source_name by URL netloc; unknown -> 'other' with warning.
build_admin_ping([]) is None; non-None matches format byte-for-byte.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Smoke: build_admin_ping([]) returned None; job() smoke produced exact byte match.

acceptance_criteria.description: Existing tests pass unchanged except auto-publish ones rewritten in same wave.
Migration test: init_db on empty DB -> all expected columns exist per PRAGMA table_info.
No new package in requirements.txt.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: requirements.txt reviewed: feedparser, requests, beautifulsoup4, deep-translator, schedule, python-telegram-bot, curl_cffi. All pre-feature.

acceptance_criteria.description: All repo SQL parametrised (no f-string/concat).
last_error written only through sanitize_error_message; all four env secrets stripped.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: tests/test_admin_ping.py; smoke: compound exception with all 4 secrets -> [REDACTED] present, no secret_ leak.

acceptance_criteria.description: preview_renderer three invariants: tag allowlist + URL-scheme allowlist + CSP meta.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: tests/test_preview_renderer.py (63 cases); smoke: javascript: dropped, default-src 'none' present.

acceptance_criteria.description: hw_review preview never calls webbrowser.open with path outside ~/.cache/hw-review/.
stage validator rejects 8 vectors: >256 KiB stdin, depth >3, unknown top keys, non-list ru_paragraphs, non-dict block, unknown block type, unknown block key, string >10 KiB.
Attempt counter shared across idle-fallback and overflow.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: repo increment_attempt single mutator; tests/test_overflow.py + tests/test_idle_fallback.py. Test audit flagged mixed-path test gap as MEDIUM (non-blocking) -- code implements correctly via shared _fallback_publish.

acceptance_criteria.description: Idle-fallback heads-up ping sent once per tick (consolidated).
acceptance_criteria.evidence: tests/test_idle_fallback.py::consolidated_ping asserts single send_admin_notification call with all three stale titles.

acceptance_criteria.description: Visual check of channel post (hashtag, preview card, Instant View button).
Visual check of local HTML preview (hero, subtitle, paragraphs, blocks order).
Real Telegraph page render fidelity (hero + subtitle + body + source footer).
Live admin-chat ping format conformance (Telegram MCP read).

static_checks.details: CI (.github/workflows/ci.yml) runs only `python -m pytest tests/ -v`. No pyproject.toml / setup.cfg / .flake8 / mypy.ini present. deploy.sh is SCP-only. No ruff/mypy/flake8 configured for this repo.

deferred_to_post_deploy.criterion: US-User-01: Visual check of channel post (hashtag, Instant View preview card, post layout) against @myhwchannel123 msg 35 golden reference.
deferred_to_post_deploy.reason: Requires live Telegram channel and human visual validation.
deferred_to_post_deploy.verificationCondition: First real hw_review publish executed against production Telegram after deploy.
deferred_to_post_deploy.verificationSteps: 1) Deploy dev branch; 2) Stage + publish one real article; 3) Open @myhwchannel123 and confirm hashtag + Instant View card + post layout match golden reference.

deferred_to_post_deploy.criterion: US-User-02: Local HTML preview visual fidelity (hero, subtitle framing, paragraph/block order, footer).
deferred_to_post_deploy.reason: Requires human visual validation of the local HTML preview in a real browser.
deferred_to_post_deploy.verificationCondition: Operator runs hw_review preview N on a staged row without --no-open.
deferred_to_post_deploy.verificationSteps: 1) python3 hw_review.py preview <N>; 2) Browser opens local HTML; 3) Confirm hero image, 💬 «subtitle», <hr>, paragraphs, blocks (if autoevolution), 'Источник:' footer all in expected order.

deferred_to_post_deploy.criterion: Tech-AVP-01: Real Telegraph page render fidelity after publish.
deferred_to_post_deploy.reason: Requires successful live publish to Telegra.ph API.
deferred_to_post_deploy.verificationCondition: After successful hw_review publish, the returned Telegraph URL is reachable.
deferred_to_post_deploy.verificationSteps: 1) curl -sL <telegraph_url> | grep -E '(figure|p|hr)'; 2) Confirm hero image, subtitle, body paragraphs, source footer all present and in order.

deferred_to_post_deploy.criterion: Tech-AVP-02: Live admin-chat ping format byte-for-byte conformance.
deferred_to_post_deploy.reason: Requires Telegram MCP access to read admin chat.
deferred_to_post_deploy.verificationCondition: After cron tick with non-empty queue.
deferred_to_post_deploy.verificationSteps: 1) Telegram MCP read admin chat last 24h; 2) Regex-match 'N ждут review: 🟠 autoevolution ×K, 🟣 mattel ×M, 🟢 lamley ×L' with zero-count sources absent.

audit_inheritance.security_audit_task12: clean -- 0 CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM, 3 LOW + 4 INFO (all P3 defense-in-depth follow-ups)
